Evidence & scope

Substantive bounded primary methods/results/limitations source review is documented at 2512.16899v3. Multimodal preference collection and agreement-filtering context establish data construction/QC scope. Ratings/pairs wording and conditional agreement are unresolved, not converted into a clean total. Original author/source-verifier/adversarial receipts bind every exact approved fact; unread pages, unreplicated experiments and source conflicts remain recorded in the pinned dossier. This admission is for one logical paper work only.

Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

The selected data exclude ambiguous or high-disagreement pairs and prioritize hard comparisons; the benchmark does not yet comprehensively cover multilingual, safety/bias, multi-turn, video or audio preferences.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

MMRB2 filters near-unanimous model-judge pairs before collecting three blinded human preferences per generative pair; it discards large rater spreads, near-midpoint averages and tied majorities, then evaluates model judges in both response orders.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

MMRB2 retains 1, 000 preference pairs for each of four tasks: text-to-image, image editing, interleaved generation and multimodal reasoning. For reasoning pairs, preferred responses must have correct answers and unanimous human agreement that their reasoning has no major errors.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

Table 2 reports Gemini 3 Pro judge-human agreement averaged across the four tasks at 76.3%, versus 72.2% for GPT-5 and 64.6% for Qwen3-VL-32 B; agreement evaluates the paper’s selected preference pairs rather than general model quality.
